svg.text: back of the switch (its lugs toward you; numbers moulded on it)
Seed3 socket (jumper ends in the right wall), seen from INSIDE, USB-C end on your LEFT
PG-1 wiring, page 1 of 10: Power: 9V jack -> power switch -> carrier board -> Seed3
Black = -, red = +. The power switch: + goes into BOTH commons (A and B); lugs 2 3 4 and 6 7 8 are all ON, so join them with bare offcuts and take ONE
wire from them to 'dc +'. Lugs 1 and 5 = OFF: leave them empty.
Steps (the number is on the wire):
9V jack: the SLEEVE lug (+) -> power switch: common A
(the inner lug marked A) (9 V + into the switch (solder))
power switch: common A (the inner lug marked A) ->
power switch: common B (the inner lug marked B) (join
power switch: lug 2 (pole A, position 2) -> board
lugs -> dc + (join A2-A4 and B2-B4 with bare offcuts
power switch: lug 2 (pole A, position 2) -> power
power switch: lug 3 (pole A, position 3) -> power
power switch: lug 4 (pole A, position 4) -> power
power switch: lug 6 (pole B, position 2) -> power
power switch: lug 7 (pole B, position 3) -> power
9V jack: the CENTRE-PIN lug (its - : centre negative) ->
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'dc -' (2nd from the left)
(9 V - straight to the board (female end on the header))
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'vin' (3rd from the left)
board 'seed3 + 9v' header: pin 'gnd' (4th from the left)
ground (the ground chain is spliced onto this wire))
